top_categories.workout_context: 203 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 203 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
At Korea Epic Ride, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
203 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
26,260ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
129ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Korea Epic Ride's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 26,260ft of climbing on mixed mountain/forest — mostly unpaved on the does to your power file on race day.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Korea Epic Ride. Train it until it feels boring.
Korea Epic Ride's mixed mountain/forest — mostly unpaved on the forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 203 miles.
Low-cadence force work for 26,260ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
26,260ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.

race_overlay.heat: June in Songjeon Beach, Sonyang-myeon, Yangyang-gun, Gangwon-do, South Korea can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Korea Epic Ride and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Fueling for 203 miles requires a practiced plan matched to expected duration, intensity, tolerance, and the course's confirmed feed or commercial resupply options. Rehearse the plan on long rides, begin early, carry redundant fuel, and avoid treating a fixed total-calorie estimate as a race prescription.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Korea Epic Ride. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Endurance, and Over Under to prepare you for 203 miles of mixed mountain/forest — mostly unpaved on the offroad routes in Songjeon Beach, Sonyang-myeon, Yangyang-gun, Gangwon-do, South Korea.
